current_route_model.E: Complete explicit load-bearing evaluators and hard constraints are independently proved; direct distributional noninferiority suffices.
current_route_model.M: Every admissible hidden utility is independently proved monotone in a sound material outcome order; a dominance-preserving coupling/stochastic-order certificate suffices.
current_route_model.U: Arbitrary or unclassified hidden utilities; exact full target/Brain trajectory-law equality is the conservative fallback and is information-irreducible under a measure-separating hidden class.

astra_prompt: This is one scarce interaction. Do not ask follow-up questions. Do not produce motivational prose. Act as an adversarial research mathematician plus benchmark/evaluator semantics investigator.

We already proved the following reduction: if hidden L1 utilities are arbitrary and measure-separating over the bound full trajectory, universal Brain noninferiority requires exact equality of Brain and target trajectory laws. Therefore do NOT spend effort trying to compress that U fallback with generic moments or a non-measure-determining statistic.
Your job is to escape U soundly for as many real target contexts as possible.

Route E is allowed only when the COMPLETE load-bearing capability evaluators and hard constraints for a context are known and proved complete. Route M is allowed only when ALL admissible hidden L1 utilities are proved monotone in a sound capability-relevant material outcome order. Otherwise the context remains U.

Research and reason from first principles about the useful Opus 5.5 target capability universe and the benchmark/evaluator/task families used to evidence it. Seek broad semantic facts, evaluator specifications, task contracts, scoring rules, environment invariants, and behavioral equivalences that can certify whole families at once.

For every proposed family-level E classification, attack evaluator completeness: find any omitted load-bearing quality, success, safety, continuation, resource, or task-contract dimension that can change whether the capability is useful.

For every proposed M classification, attack monotonicity with the smallest preference reversal or nonmonotone hidden utility counterexample. Never infer monotonicity merely because an outcome dimension sounds desirable.

Search for context generators or quotients only where a precise symmetry, invariance, contract refinement, bisimulation, evaluator equivalence, or other transfer theorem preserves all load-bearing L1 semantics. Give the exact transfer premise; otherwise reject the quotient.
Prioritize statements that collapse many contexts. Prefer one structural proof over many individual facts.
If public primary evidence is available, cite the exact primary source and what proposition it establishes. Separate sourced facts from your own theorem reasoning.
Do not invent hidden Opus internals, private benchmark results, or unavailable target distributions.

Return the minimum external-information cut after classification: which semantics can be proved once globally, which per family, which per context, and which residual U cases truly require exact target trajectory-law information.
For every positive theorem/classification, provide the cheapest decisive counterexample test that could falsify it.
End with exactly one highest-leverage next action after independent verification.

required_output.family_classification: List proposed target context families with route E, M, U, or UNRESOLVED; exact semantic premise; source/proof status; and breadth of contexts covered.
required_output.E_completeness_candidates: For each E family, enumerate the complete claimed evaluator/hard-constraint basis and a falsifier for omission.
required_output.M_monotonicity_candidates: For each M family, define the material partial order, admissible hidden utility class, and a falsifier for nonmonotonicity.
required_output.context_generators: Any sound quotient/generator theorem with exact invariance premises and counterexample boundary.
required_output.residual_U: Exact classes that cannot be moved soundly out of U and why.
required_output.top_counterexamples: At least 10 minimal counterexamples against the strongest proposed shortcuts.
required_output.sourced_evidence: Primary-source evidence only, with claim-to-source mapping.
required_output.next_single_action: One action maximizing expected terminal obligations closed per unit cost.
